wta_species.name: MACD Hunter
wta_species.description: Hunts for momentum shifts using MACD crossovers. Excels at catching trend changes early.

live_decision_source.label: MACD 12/26/9 histogram and EMA 9/21 must agree; abstains when they disagree

wta_species.name: RSI Sniper
wta_species.description: Snipes oversold and overbought conditions. Patient hunter waiting for perfect RSI setups.

live_decision_source.label: RSI-14 on epoch closes — YES above 60 and rising, NO below 40 and falling, else sits out

wta_species.name: Bollinger Bandit
wta_species.description: Exploits volatility expansions and contractions using Bollinger Bands. Thrives in high-volatility markets.

live_decision_source.label: Bollinger Bands 20/2σ on epoch closes — YES on a close above the upper band, NO below the lower band (%B, bandwidth expansion raises confidence)

wta_species.name: Volume Viper
wta_species.description: Strikes only when volume confirms the move. Uses OBV, Volume Profile, and VWAP for precision entries. Live 5-minute clones of this species decide on: Prior-epoch direction (cross-market correlation) (CORR).

wta_species.name: Trend Titan
wta_species.description: Multi-timeframe trend follower using EMA ribbons and ADX. Holds winners, cuts losers fast.
wta_species.tagline: Ride the trend until it ends

live_decision_source.label: EMA 9/21/50 ribbon on epoch closes — YES when close > EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50, NO when fully stacked bearish; ADX not applied (needs intrabar range)

wta_species.name: Stochastic Striker
wta_species.description: Lightning-fast striker using Stochastic oscillators. Capitalizes on momentum exhaustion.

live_decision_source.label: Stochastic %K(14)/%D(3) on epoch closes — YES when %K > 80 rising or > 70 above %D, NO when %K < 20 falling or < 30 below %D

wta_species.name: Ichimoku Empress
wta_species.description: Ancient Japanese trading wisdom. Uses all 5 Ichimoku components for complete market structure analysis.

live_decision_source.label: Ichimoku on epoch closes — Tenkan 9 / Kijun 26 / Senkou A / Senkou B 52: YES above the cloud with Tenkan > Kijun, NO below with Tenkan < Kijun; Chikou not applied

wta_species.name: Fibonacci Phoenix
wta_species.description: Rises from pullbacks at golden ratio levels. Master of Fibonacci retracements and extensions.

live_decision_source.label: Fibonacci retracement of the last 50 epoch closes — at a 23.6/38.2/50/61.8/78.6% level, a 5-epoch bounce is YES, a break is NO; extensions not applied

wta_species.name: ATR Alpha
wta_species.description: Uses ATR for dynamic stop-losses and position sizing. Adapts to changing volatility conditions.

live_decision_source.label: ATR-14 (close-to-close) vs its 20-epoch mean — expanding volatility (>1.2x) takes the 5-epoch direction: YES up, NO down; Keltner/Chaikin not applied

wta_species.name: Divergence Dragon
wta_species.description: Breathes fire on divergence setups. Spots hidden and regular divergences between price and indicators. Live 5-minute clones of this species decide on: Fades prior-epoch rallies; rides existing downtrends (FADE).

live_decision_source.label: Fades prior-epoch rallies; rides existing downtrends

wta_species.name: Perceptron Oracle
wta_species.description: Uses a three-layer perceptron neural network to automatically learn optimal signal weights from trade outcomes. Layer 1 (Species): learns per-species TA signal combinations. Layer 2 (Ensemble): combines all 10 species into consensus predictions. Layer 3 (Clone): inherits species weights at clone time, then diverges via your own trade history. Replaces hardcoded 70/30 heuristic with online gradient descent — gets smarter every epoch. Live 5-minute clones of this species decide on: Single-layer perceptron on five epoch-close features (1/3/10-epoch returns, RSI-14, 5-vs-20 volatility ratio), retrained online by gradient descent over the clone's window before every decision — YES at a score ≥ 0.60, NO at ≤ 0.40, else sits out (PCPN).
wta_species.tagline: Neural signal weighting — learns from every trade

live_decision_source.label: Single-layer perceptron on five epoch-close features (1/3/10-epoch returns, RSI-14, 5-vs-20 volatility ratio), retrained online by gradient descent over the clone's window before every decision — YES at a score ≥ 0.60, NO at ≤ 0.40, else sits out

perpetual_agents.name: Liquidation Hunter
perpetual_agents.description: Identifies over-leveraged positions using 5-pillar analysis: liquidation heatmap (pool imbalance), funding rate pressure, OI buildup patterns, Fibonacci confluence, and volume confirmation. Executes Bear Hunts (bet NO when longs are over-leveraged) and Bull Hunts (bet YES when shorts are squeezable).

perpetual_agents.name: Stat Oracle
perpetual_agents.description: Uses statistical analysis of recent epoch outcomes to identify streaks and reversion patterns. Data-driven decision making.

perpetual_agents.name: Corr Catcher
perpetual_agents.description: Exploits correlations between crypto assets. Reads BTC momentum to predict ETH direction, using cross-market signals.

perpetual_agents.name: Sent Surfer
perpetual_agents.description: Rides momentum waves with confidence scaling. Higher conviction when price trends are sustained, adapts to sentiment shifts.

perpetual_agents.name: Fade the Rally
perpetual_agents.description: Fades rallies with NO bets. Stronger conviction when rallies are bigger. Rides existing downtrends with moderate NO positions.

perpetual_agents.name: Doom & Gloom
perpetual_agents.description: Measures last epoch price swings. High volatility signals fear and falling prices. Scales NO confidence with swing magnitude.

perpetual_agents.name: Vortex Drain
perpetual_agents.description: Uses epoch modular arithmetic to identify cyclical selling windows. Bets NO during selling pressure phases, hedges YES during recovery windows.

perpetual_agents.name: Sync Master
perpetual_agents.description: Alternates YES/NO positions across epochs for balanced exposure. Captures variance while minimizing directional risk.

perpetual_agents.name: Crash Detector
perpetual_agents.description: Tracks consecutive NO-win epochs and rides crash streaks. When drops cluster, conviction grows. Hedges mildly bullish when no streak detected.

perpetual_agents.name: Delta Hunter
perpetual_agents.description: Hunts price reversals after large swings. Bets on reversion when volatility spikes, follows trend when markets are calm.

perpetual_agents.name: Dread Gauge
perpetual_agents.description: Reads scored headlines for high-impact bearish news. Higher average impact scores drive stronger NO conviction. Falls back to mild bull when news is calm.
